# Jarvis Strategies

> Jarvis Strategies embeds inside trades, construction, and manufacturing companies across the Okanagan (Vernon, Kelowna, Penticton, Kamloops), British Columbia to identify, build, and deploy AI systems connected to real operational workflows — then stays in as an ongoing partner.

Led by Scott Jarvis, 18 years in trades and construction operations before moving into AI implementation. The approach is practical-first: use cases have to connect to real workflows (estimating, proposals, documentation, subcontractor coordination), not generic AI hype. Every workflow ships with governance built in — accountability, data boundaries, quality control, transparency.

## Site
- [Homepage](https://jarvisstrategies.com/): Services, governance philosophy, results, about Scott Jarvis, and contact
- [AI Readiness Assessment](https://jarvisstrategies.com/assessment): Free 7-question, 2-minute assessment that scores AI readiness and surfaces use cases
- [Blog index](https://jarvisstrategies.com/blog/): Practical AI thinking for trades and construction — no hype
